bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = a6a84876ab8ff9a81503ac15d1a3285e50634e1e
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1)" = true
for p in server/workflow.js server/control/real-debug-benchmark.js server/adapters/external-review.js server/adapters/external-review-quota.js server/control/invocation-compiler.js server/control/role-output-validator.js; do
  test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 sha256sum "/app/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)" = false
python3 -B /home/admin1/server-core/scripts/servercore_registered_service_deploy.py --repository seigo-gace/debug-ai --target-sha a6a84876ab8ff9a81503ac15d1a3285e50634e1e --service debug-ai --apply
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)" = true
for p in server/workflow.js server/control/real-debug-benchmark.js server/adapters/external-review.js server/adapters/external-review-quota.js server/control/invocation-compiler.js server/control/role-output-validator.js; do
  test "$(sha256sum "$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 sha256sum "/app/$p" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
done
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
def get(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+path,timeout=10) as response:
        return json.load(response)
health=get("/health")
assert health["ok"], health
s=get("/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/realdebug_6cf69ffdd7f641cba693aa2e9783c9aa")
assert s["state"]=="PAUSED" and not s["active_in_process"], s
assert s["pause_reason"]=="INTERRUPTED_BENCHMARK_REQUIRES_RESUME", s
d=get("/v1/status/"+s["current"]["run_id"])["durable"]
assert d["job_status"]=="PAUSED" and not d["active_in_process"], d
print("PRODUCTION_HEALTH_OK BENCHMARK_AND_CHILD_PAUSED")
PY
